topic: If AI coding is lowering your code quality, you're not managing quality right
headline: AI Coding and Quality Balance
caption: As a full stack engineer, I've seen AI tools boost productivity but also sometimes lead to rushed or less meticulous code. The key is managing quality through strict code reviews and testing, no matter who writes it. AI is a powerful helper, but it doesn't replace good engineering practices. If your code quality dips, revisit your processes. Remember, automation is only as good as the guardrails you set! 🚀 Keep your standards high and leverage AI wisely. #SoftwareEngineering #CodeQuality #AIandDev
